news.title: The White House is asking OpenAI to slow roll the release of its new model over safety concerns
news.description: penAI reportedly plans to share its newest model, GPT 5.6, with a select group of partners instead of to the broader public. The reason: the Trump administration told it to.

news.title: Patronus AI lands $50M to build ‘digital worlds’ that stress-test AI agents
news.description: Agent-testing startup Patronus AI, founded by former Meta AI researchers, is experiencing nearly insatiable demand, its investor says.

news.title: Anthropic’s Claude is winning over paid consumers, a market owned by ChatGPT
news.description: Despite ChatGPT's commanding market lead, consumers who pay for AI have been increasingly choosing Anthropic's Claude, data shows.

news.title: General Intuition’s $2.3B bet that video games can train AI agents for the real world
news.description: General Intuition has raised $320 million to scale AI trained on millions of hours of gameplay, betting action data can help AI develop something closer to human intuition.

news.title: Databricks’ former AI chief thinks he can cut AI’s power bill by 1,000x
news.description: Un-0 is an image-generation system tool that shows for the first time how the company's technology can replicate conventional AI systems.

news.title: Apple hikes some prices by nearly 20% while Xbox raises console cost
news.description: Apple said it had "never seen a component price increase this much, this quickly".

news.title: IBM hails new 'block of flats' design breakthrough for ultra tiny chips
news.description: IBM says it has created the world's first known chip tech below 1 nanometre - but it will be some time before it's ready for production.

news.title: Anthropic Thinks Its Own Success Is Key to Making AI Safe
news.description: Anthropic's critics argue it's rapidly accumulating power. The company says that's what responsible AI development looks like.
